system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
**CONFIDENTIAL – BUYER LEGAL ADVICE**  
**Project Kestrel – Seller SPA/Disclosure Letter Review**  
**Prepared for: Wattlebridge Holdings Deal Team**  
**Date: [Current]**

---

### EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The Seller’s “final” package **does not reflect our agreed commercial bargain**—it reflects the Seller’s wish-list. Almost every key protection in our Playbook is either missing, weakened, or affirmatively contradicted. The Seller’s “Reviewer Efficiency Note” and pervasive **[STANDARD]** labels are a procedural tactic to narrow our review; we have **not** accepted the disclosure framework, limitation package, or any of the substantive positions marked **[STANDARD]**.

**Bottom line:** We must issue a comprehensive mark-up reversing every departure below. No “fallback” positions (20% cap, 18-month period, title under general regime) are authorised—Amelia Frost has given **no written approval** for any of them.

---

## MATERIAL DEPARTURES FROM PLAYBOOK (WITH REASONING)

| # | Playbook Requirement | Seller’s Position | Departure & Risk | Push-Back Required |
|---|----------------------|-------------------|------------------|-------------------|
| **1** | **General Cap: 25% / AUD 6M** (20% / AUD 4.8M only with Frost written authority—**none given**) | Cl. 12.1: **20% / AUD 4.8M** | **Unauthorised fallback.** Seller treats 20% as “standard agreed.” We lose AUD 1.2M of protection. | **Revert to 25% / AUD 6M.** Delete any reference to 20% as “agreed.” |
| **2** | **De minimis AUD 5k; Basket AUD 50k (first-dollar recovery once exceeded)** | Cl. 12.2: **De minimis AUD 25k; Basket AUD 250k (excess only)** | **5× wider thresholds.** Seller escapes first AUD 250k of aggregate claims; we bear AUD 245k more risk per claim. | **Reset to AUD 5k / AUD 50k, first-dollar.** |
| **3** | **General claims period: 24 months** (18 months only with Frost approval—**none**) | Cl. 12.3/13: **18 months**; “any limitation applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise” | **Unauthorised fallback + trojan horse:** 18 months cuts 6 months off discovery window; the “all Claims” language tries to swallow fundamental/title/fraud claims. | **24 months.** Delete “applies to all Claims” sweep-up. |
| **4** | **Fundamental/Title: separate regime — 100% cap, ≥6 years, outside basket/de minimis/knowledge bar** | “Capacity and title warranties subject to same caps and time limits as general warranties for administrative simplicity.” | **Catastrophic.** Title/capacity defects (e.g., Seller doesn’t own shares, encumbrances) would be capped at AUD 4.8M, time-barred at 18 months, subject to AUD 250k basket and buyer-knowledge bar. | **Standalone Title/Capacity regime:** 100% cap, 6+ years, no basket, no de minimis, no knowledge qualifier. |
| **5** | **Fraud/wilful concealment/deliberate misconduct: carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance** | Cl. 9.3/12.8/20.5: “Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to **all Claims of any nature**.” | **Explicitly includes fraud.** Seller seeks to cap/time-bar/limit remedy for own fraud. Unenforceable in NSW but creates litigation risk; must be excised. | **Express carve-out** for fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct from every limitation. |
| **6** | **Disclosure: specific fair disclosure only; reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure** | Disclosure Letter §§1.1–1.2: **General disclosure of entire data room (DD-002–DD-012), Accounts, statutory registers, public records.** | **Whole-data-room deemed disclosure.** Shifts burden to us to find needles in haystack; contradicts NSW “fair disclosure” standard. | **Delete general disclosure clauses.** Require specific, document-by-document disclosure with page references. |
| **7** | **Buyer knowledge: delete blanket exclusions; any qualifier needs named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry; never excuse title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity** | Cl. 8.3: “No claim for any matter **Buyer or its advisers had knowledge**, including any matter **discoverable from data room or public records**.” | **Constructive knowledge (“discoverable”) + adviser knowledge + blanket bar.** Would defeat claims for matters buried in 1,000+ page data room; applies to title/fraud/indemnities. | **Strike Cl. 8.3 entirely.** If Seller insists on knowledge qualifier: (a) actual knowledge only, (b) named Buyer individuals, (c) no adviser imputation, (d) carve-outs for title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnities. |
| **8** | **Bluefen: effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied **before** Completion; reasonable endeavours insufficient** | Cl. 3/6.3: **Reasonable endeavours only**; consent “satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent.” Disclosure §2: **No final consent, no evidence conditions met** as at 22 Sept 2026. | **Material customer (30% revenue) consent not secured.** “Delivery” ≠ conditions satisfied (DD-002 §11.3). Post-Completion consent failure = buyer bears revenue cliff risk. | **Condition Precedent: Bluefen consent + condition satisfaction evidence.** No “reasonable endeavours” fallback. |
| **9** | **Riverlark: current payout from Completion funds + security releases; post-Completion release only with irrevocable undertaking + Frost approval** | Cl. 2/7: **Release “following Completion”** (post-Completion). Disclosure §3: **Not repaid, no discharge** as at 22 Sept 2026. | **AUD 3.2M debt remains on Target post-Completion.** Buyer funds payout indirectly; security releases uncertain; no irrevocable undertaking. | **Riverlark paid **at** Completion from Completion funds; security discharges delivered at Completion.** If Seller insists on post-Completion: irrevocable undertaking + Frost written approval (not given). |
| **10** | **Employee bonuses (DD-005): AUD 420k + on-costs as specific line item or Seller-funded; funds flow must not silently exclude** | “Bonuses are a matter for the Seller and **not separately itemised in funds flow**.” Disclosure §5: **Not in funds flow; on-costs unstated.** | **Hidden AUD 420k+ liability.** If Target pays, purchase price effectively reduced; if Seller pays, no mechanism. On-costs (payroll tax, super) could add ~15–20%. | **Specific line item in Completion funds flow (gross + on-costs) OR Seller-funded
=== END ADVICE ===
